Tables 2.2.1 to 2.2.5 updated.

Table 2.6.2 updated.

Tables 221, 222, 223, 224, 231, 232, 233, 234 updated. When first published they excluded provisional 2020 household bills, but we have now republished including the provisional bills estimates. All other data relate to July to September (Quarter 3 2020) and are unchanged.
